alert: Service is suspended until further notice due to signal issues. Find alternate routes here or use the Trip Planner on SEPTA.org or in the SEPTA App.
advisory:
West Trenton Station Waiting Room Closed

Due to vandalism, the waiting room at West Trenton Station is closed until further notice. Report problems using the SEPTA App (available for iOS and Android); the “Help” tab lets you discreetly report incidents or suspicious activity in seconds.

Trevose Station Outbound Platform Closed (southern portion only)

Due to drainage improvements, the southern portion of the outbound platform at Trevose Station is closed from Tuesday, December 1 through Monday, December 7. Passengers must board outbound trains from the northern portion, which remains ADA accessible. Parking spaces on Rail Ave, next to the outbound platform are unavailable; please use the parking lot on the inbound side at Boundbrook & Growden aves.

Norristown High Speed Line is Now the M
